title: Luxuriantly Fatty Russian Black Beans Dumplings
description: A festive Russian dish featuring fermented black beans and cure, this recipe is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly and perfect for special occasions.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the fermented black beans, all-purpose flour, buckwheat flour, and cure.
Add the melted unsalted butter, eggs, sour cream, chopped fresh dill, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into small pieces and shape each piece into a dumpling.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the dumplings for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot.
Garnish with additional chopped fresh dill and sour cream, if desired.
